q: Gareth Evans yava wa, era kiki ekyabumba emyaka gye egy'omu buto?
a: Yazaalibwa mu 1938 mu Merthyr Tydfil, wakati mu biwonvu bya amanda mu Wales ey'Obukiikaddyo, mu Cyril Evans, omusajja wa RAF ajjukirwa olw'okuyimba kwe n'okwagala kwe kkulikeeti, ne Ethel, omukubi w'ennanga ow'ekitalo. Ennyimba, emizannyo n'okunyumya byakulukutira mu maka. Ng'aweza emyaka munaana yasenguka mu nnyumba ya jjajjaawe mu Bonvilston, era ng'aweza kkumi na emu n'ayingira Cowbridge Grammar School, ng'alaga omutwe ogw'ekitalo ku by'okubala. Bwe yali aweza emyaka kkumi n'esatu maama we yafa, era ennaku n'ekaka omulenzi mu bwannamunigina obw'amangu.

q: Gareth Evans yatuuka atya ku kukkiriza?
a: Yakulira mu maka aga Angirikaani naye "nga tannaba kunywezebwa mu kukkiriza okwo," era enkyukakyuka yajja ng'aweza emyaka kkumi na mukaaga mu nkuŋŋaana z'abavubuka za ku Lwakutaano ekiro eza Betty Bishop, bwe yamubuuza butereevu nti: "Onookola ki ne Mukama Yesu Kristo?" Okumala wiiki ttaano yakyewala, okutuusa omubuulizi omuvubuka ayitibwa Austin bwe yamubuuza ebigambo bye bimu. Ekiro ekyo yafukamira mu kusaba omulundi ogusooka okuva ku kufa kwa maama we; oluvannyuma lwa katono, mu lukuŋŋaana lw'essomero, "yajjuzibwa obukakafu bw'okusonyiyibwa n'okubeerawo kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu."

Gwava ku Mr. Aubrey Evans ow'e Swansea, eyamugamba nti abo abagoberera nga bali ewala basobola okulaba Mukama, naye abo abakulembera Ekitangaala ky'ensi ekigere kimu batambulira mu kisiikirize kyabwe. Mu kubuulirira okwo mwe mwava omulamwa Gareth gw'akuumye okuva olwo: "Nnaatambula ne Yesu, si mu maaso ge wadde okusigala emabega."

Okumala emyaka amakumi abiri ekituuti kye kyali kibiina ky'essomero. Yasomesa fiziika e Kenfig, oluvannyuma n'afuuka omusomesa asinga obuto eyali apangisiddwa Minisitule y'Eby'okwerinda ku Windsor Boys School mu Bugirimaani, ng'afuna ebifo ebirala oluvannyuma mu Hamm ne mu Hong Kong, ne mu Kanada ku Toronto French School ne ku Toronto Hebrew Academy. Buli gye yasomesezanga yayogeranga n'obujulizi, ng'atandika Ebibiina by'Abakristaayo, era mu Hong Kong ne yeegatta ku mulimu gwa Jackie Pullinger mu banywi b'ebiragalalagala mu kibuga ekyaliko bbugwe eky'e Kowloon.

q: Omusomesa wa fiziika yafuuka atya omusumba?
a: Bwe yali ku Toronto Hebrew Academy, omusumba w'ekkanisa ye bwe yeeyawula, Gareth yayitibwa okwogera ku lukuŋŋaana lw'okusiibula, era abasumba babiri ab'edda ne bamugamba mu bwerufu nti ekifo kye kyali mu buweereza. N'obuwagizi bwa Anne obw'omutima gwonna yaleka okusomesa n'agenda mu Christian and Missionary Alliance, ng'aweereza ku Hazelglen Fellowship mu Kitchener n'oluvannyuma okumala emyaka munaana ku Victoria Alliance Church — byonna, nga bw'ajjukiza, "awatali lunaku lumu mu ttendekero ly'eby'okutendekebwamu."

q: Obuweereza bwe ku lyato ery'okusaasira bwali butya?
a: Oluvannyuma lw'obulwadde obwa mangu okumuggya mu buweereza okumala emyaka ebiri, ye ne Anne beegatta ku lyato ery'okusaasira M/V Anastasis mu Rotterdam mu 1991 ng'abasumba mu Afirika ey'Obugwanjuba. N'abaminsani banaabwe baazimba amasomero, ebitundu by'eddwaliro, ebifo by'obujjanjabi n'ensulo z'amazzi amayonjo, so nga essanyu lya Gareth erisingira ddala lyali mu kusomesa — ng'ayigiriza abakulembeze b'amakanisa abasukka mu 150 mu Sierra Leone era ng'atwala obuweereza bwe mu Guinea, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal ne Naijeriya.

q: Kiki ekyali eky'enjawulo mu buweereza bwe obw'okutambula obw'oluvannyuma?
a: Bwe yava ku Anastasis mu 1994, teyava mu bulamu bw'okutambula bwe lyali limuggulidde. Yakulembera essomero ly'ekyeya ku Capernwray mu Australia era n'addamu okuyitibwa okungi — Amasomero ga YWAM ag'Okutendeka Abayigirizwa mu Mexico ne Brazil, n'obuweereza mu India, Nepal, Haiti ne Bungereza. Alambika emyaka amakumi nga essuula: abaserikale Abagurika mu Hong Kong mu myaka gya nkaaga, abavubuka b'e Bridgend mu myaka gy'ensanvu, Academy y'Abayudaaya mu myaka gy'ekinaana, abasumba b'omu Afirika ey'Obugwanjuba mu myaka gy'ekyenda.

Yeeyogerako ng'omunyumya, era okuwandiika kwe kwangu, kwa mpola era kwa busumba, nga kugenderera ekkanisa ebonaabona. Ebitabo nga "He Holds My Tomorrows", "Ekisumuluzo Ekiri mu Mukono Gwange", "Stepping Stones", "Soar Like the Eagle" ne "Feasting at the Table" bitwala omusomi mpolampola mu Byawandiikibwa, nga bigatta okunnyonnyola okw'obwegendereza n'okugumya kw'omusajja eyalabirira ebibiina ebyennyini mu buzibu obwennyini.

q: Kiki eky'enjawulo mu ndaba ye ku kukkiriza?
a: Ku Abaebbulaniya 11 awandiika nti: "Abamu bandituumye 'Abazira b'Okukkiriza'. Nze siraba bazira eyo." Eri Gareth ebyokulabirako ebikulu eby'okukkiriza si bantu banene abateekwa okwewuunyizibwa nga basinziira ewala mu bukuumi, wabula abantu abaabulijjo, abaliko obukyamu, abaakkiriza Katonda ku kigambo kye — ekitegeeza nti okukkiriza kwabwe kwe kukkiriza omusomi asobola ddala okugabana. Okukkiriza, bw'anywereza, kukolera, kwa banafu nga bwe kuli kwa b'amaanyi, era kutambulirwa ekigere kimu eky'okugondera mu kiseera.

Ng'atali nate asibiddwa ku kituuti kimu, Gareth aweereza okusinga ng'ayita ku mukutu gwe, gye ebiwandiiko bye eby'okwewaayo, ebitabo n'ennyimba bikuŋŋaanyiza amagezi ag'olugendo olugazi eri abaasaasaana n'abali obwannamunigina. Atwala omugugu ogw'enjawulo ku lw'abavubuka — okubayigiriza n'okubategeka okutuuka ku bukulu mu Kristo — era akyatambula ng'agoberera omulamwa ogwamuweebwa edda: si mu maaso ga Yesu, si ng'asigala emabega, wabula naye, ejjinja ery'okulinnyako limu ku limu.
